messages:
Ashley: Hey team — customer 'Orion' is ramping in SEA and we need a new GPU nodepool in asia-southeast1. Prefer A100 for low-latency inference, but our regional A100 quota looks tight. Can we do a mixed strategy (small dedicated A100 pool + larger spot/T4 pool)? Need autoscaler/min/max suggestions and any networking/quota gotchas. ETA: end of week.

Mike: Quick checks — GCP regional A100 quota is 24 GPUs right now for our project, T4 quota is plenty (~200). If we need >24 A100 we have to request a quota increase which is ~48–72h. Also zone availability can be flaky; recommend reserving the pool in a single zone with fallback policy.

Raj: I would do two pools:
- reserved-a100: a2-highgpu nodes, taint="gpu=dedicated:NoSchedule", min=1 max=4 (for steady low-latency)
- burst-t4-spot: t4/g4dn equivalent, preemptible/spot, taint="gpu=spot:NoSchedule", min=0 max=12 (for batch/overflow)

Use tolerations on pods. Autoscaler settings: scale-up-delay 0s, scale-down-unneeded-time 10m for reserved pool, 5m for spot pool. Keep separate LB/backend configs so we can route low-latency traffic to reserved pool only.

Example GKE node-pool create (rough):
```
# reserved A100
gcloud container node-pools create reserved-a100 \
  --cluster=prod-sea --zone=asia-southeast1-a \
  --machine-type=a2-highgpu-1g --accelerator=type=nvidia-tesla-a100,count=1 \
  --num-nodes=1 --enable-autoscaling --min-nodes=1 --max-nodes=4 \
  --node-taints=gpu=dedicated:NoSchedule
\n# spot T4 pool
gcloud container node-pools create burst-t4-spot \
  --cluster=prod-sea --zone=asia-southeast1-a \
  --machine-type=n1-standard-16 --accelerator=type=nvidia-tesla-t4,count=1 \
  --num-nodes=0 --enable-autoscaling --min-nodes=0 --max-nodes=12 \
  --preemptible --node-taints=gpu=spot:NoSchedule
```

Julia: Networking gotcha — our current VPC secondary range for pods in that subnet is a /22, which limits max pods/nodes. If we spin up >50 nodes we'll run out of IPs. Also check regional internal load balancer quota and ephemeral external IP quota (we allocate for canaries). Recommend bumping secondary range to /20 and verifying routes.

Mike: Also watch GPU node startup time — A100 images + drivers + container image pull can add ~2–3m. Consider node prewarming for the reserved pool (keep 1 warmed node). For spot pool, set pod disruption budgets and graceful fallback to CPU path.

sre-bot: reminder: open a quota support ticket with GCP and include project id + exact accelerator types/region. Link: https://console.cloud.google.com/iam-admin/quotas

Ashley: Thanks — I'll open the GCP quota request now and create infra ticket with the above plan. Tagging @cloud-ops and @platform for review. Will post updates here. :thumbsup:
